main.toolTipHeader: Pauza - The break time reminder app
main.warning: This will restore app defaults and all your settings will be lost.

settings.openAtLogin: Start Pauza automatically when logging in
settings.monitorIdleTime: Monitor system idle time (breaks are paused if system is idle).
settings.monitorDnd: Show breaks even in Do Not Disturb mode
settings.interruptionStyleInfo: Choose how assertively Pauza appears when a break starts.

schedule.miniBreaksInfo: Microbreaks are short breaks taken regularly to give you a chance to stretch and relax.
schedule.longBreaksInfo: Breaks are taken less regularly, but last longer, allowing you to step away from your work for a fuller reset.
schedule.strictModeInfo: Strict mode prevents you from skipping either Microbreaks or Breaks and is designed to help discipline.
schedule.cantDisableBoth: It is not possible to disable both types of breaks

about.learnMore: To learn more about Pauza features, view a tutorial, download the latest version or contact us for support,
about.designedBy: Icon and UI design by Colin Shanley

heart.desc1: Taking regular breaks when using a computer is scientifically proven to be important for your physical and mental well-being.
heart.desc2: Pauza is free. But you can lend your support by donating and help us continue to improve Pauza and release other free software.

contributorPreferences.title: Contributor Preferences
contributorPreferences.notificationsInfo: System notification shown before breaks to let you prepare for it.
contributorPreferences.newVersionNotification: Notify when new version is available
contributorPreferences.customIdeasInfo: Allows you to use custom break ideas by editing configuration file. (For advanced users.)
contributorPreferences.useIdeasFromSettings: Use break ideas from configuration file
contributorPreferences.breakPostponeInfo: If enabled in main Preferences, you can postpone breaks. Following settings allow you to specify when, for how long and how many times you can postpone a break.
contributorPreferences.pauseUntilMorningInfo: Specify till what hour 'Pause until morning' should pause.
contributorPreferences.showWelcomeWindow: Show Welcome window on next start
contributorPreferences.opacityInfo: How solid should the break window be?
contributorPreferences.breakWindowSizeInfo: What percentage of the screen should the break window hide?
contributorPreferences.miniBreakStartSound: Sound at the start of Microbreak
contributorPreferences.longBreakStartSound: Sound at the start of Break
contributorPreferences.naturalBreaksInfo: If monitoring of idle time is enabled in main Preferences, you can specify after what time the breaks should be paused.
contributorPreferences.showBreaksAsRegularWindowsInfo: When enabled, break windows will become focusable, they won't be 'Always on top' anymore and they will also appear in the taskbar.
contributorPreferences.screenInfo: When showing breaks on all monitors is disabled, you can choose which one you would like to show your breaks on.
contributorPreferences.showTimeToBreakInTray: Show time to next break in tray
contributorPreferences.showCurrentTimeInBreaks: Show current local time in break window

ui.title: Pauza
ui.heroHeadline: Protect your rhythm with a quieter interface
ui.heroSubtitle: Keep the high-frequency choices up front and tuck stronger controls into Advanced.
ui.settingsCategoriesHint: Switch categories on the left, review the current section in the center, and keep save status on the right.
ui.overviewHint: Status summary, latest actions and quick controls.
ui.liveOverviewHint: Your current rhythm, runtime state and break surface stay visible here.
ui.quickActionsHint: These actions apply directly to the rhythm that is already running.
ui.savePanelHint: Changes are written to the desktop runtime only after you save.
ui.sectionScheduleHint: Keep only the rhythm you actually adjust day to day.
ui.longBreaksHint: A fuller reset after a few rounds.
ui.sectionSignalsHint: Let Pauza decide more intelligently when to step in.
ui.naturalBreaksHint: Reset after you have been away long enough.
ui.dndHint: Pause while system focus mode is on
ui.sectionSurfaceHint: Control how strong the break card feels and where it appears.
ui.sectionGeneralHint: A few global preferences, kept intentionally minimal.
ui.notificationsCategoryHint: Review heads-up timing and postpone rules in one place.
ui.surfaceCategoryHint: Control how breaks appear, where they open and how strict they feel.
ui.smartPauseHint: Pauza waits for a clear pause first. If none appears, it starts after a fixed maximum wait.
ui.generalAndShortcutsHint: Manage language, launch behavior and keyboard entry points.
ui.sectionAdvancedHint: Deeper controls, compatibility options and shortcuts.
ui.appExclusionsHint: Match process names or command fragments.
ui.resetScheduleHint: Restart the timers from now. If breaks are paused, this does not resume them.
ui.postponeCategoryHint: Set postpone duration and limits separately for microbreaks and breaks.
ui.breakBackdropHint: Give the break window a more atmospheric host background.
ui.customWallpaperHint: Upload a local image and use it as the break window backdrop.
ui.customWallpaperEmptyHint: If you switch to Custom wallpaper without an image, Pauza falls back to the default theme.
ui.customWallpaperReady: The selected image is compressed and stored locally so future breaks can reuse it.
ui.breakIdeasHint: Show one concise prompt inside each break window.
ui.breakSoundsHint: Play a short sound when a break begins and ends.
ui.reminderModeHint: Smart waits for a clear pause first, then starts after a fixed maximum wait if needed. Forced starts on time and locks the break.
ui.showTimeToBreakInTray: Show time to next break in tray
ui.currentTimeInBreaksHint: Keep the current system time visible in the top-right corner.
ui.strictModesHint: Control whether breaks can be bypassed and whether finishing requires a manual confirmation.
ui.showTrayMenuInStrictMode: Keep tray menu available in strict mode
ui.shortcutsHint: Leave blank to disable. Example: CmdOrCtrl+Shift+P

breakCopy.clearedDetail: There is no active break right now.
breakCopy.manualAwaiting: Time is up. Finish this break before jumping back in.

defaultPrompt.microbreak: Stand up, release your shoulders, and look farther away.
defaultPrompt.longBreak: Step away for a few minutes and let your posture fully reset.

previewAction.pause: Preview mode: breaks paused for 30 minutes.
previewAction.autostartOn: Preview mode: launch on login enabled.
previewAction.autostartOff: Preview mode: launch on login disabled.

actions.focusVia: Focus session enabled for {{minutes}} minutes via {{source}}.
actions.postponeDisabled: Postpone is disabled for this break.
actions.forcedBreakLocked: This is a forced break. Finish it before changing the schedule.
actions.dndStarted: Do Not Disturb is active. Breaks paused.
actions.dndEnded: Do Not Disturb ended. Schedule resumed.
actions.naturalBreakDetected: Natural break detected. Waiting until you return.
actions.waitingForOpportunity: {{title}} is due, so Pauza is waiting for a natural pause first.
actions.awaitingRecoveryCredit: {{title}} is due, but you've already been away for a while. Pauza will settle it when you return.
actions.recoveryMicrobreakCredited: You were away for {{duration}}, so this {{title}} was credited automatically.
actions.recoveryLongBreakDeferred: You were away for {{duration}}, so {{title}} was deferred by {{credit}}.
actions.manualFinishWaiting: {{title}} timer ended. Waiting for manual finish.
actions.autostartDisabledFromTray: Launch on login disabled from tray.
actions.autostartEnabledFromTray: Launch on login enabled from tray.

microbreak.title: Microbreak
microbreak.detail: Stand up, soften your shoulders and look away from the screen.

long.title: Break
long.detail: Step away for a few minutes and let your posture fully reset.

status.manualFinishDetail: The timer ended. Finish the break to resume reminders.
status.pausedForeverDetail: Breaks are paused until you resume manually.
status.dndDetail: Breaks are paused until focus mode ends.
status.naturalDetail: You have been away long enough to reset the schedule.
status.headsUpAdaptiveDetail: {{kind}} should start in about {{duration}}. If you're still active, Pauza will wait for a cleaner pause first.
status.recoveryDetail: You've been away for about {{duration}}. Pauza will settle this {{kind}} when you return.
status.waitingOpportunityDetail: {{kind}} is due. Pauza looks for a clearer pause first and will wait at most {{duration}} more before starting.
status.idleDetail: Enable at least one break type to start scheduling.

appExclusion.pauseGeneric: Breaks paused because an excluded app is active.
appExclusion.resumeGeneric: Breaks paused until a resume-listed app is active.

notifications.longBreakAdaptiveSoon: {{title}} is coming up. Pauza will look for a natural pause first and start after a fixed maximum wait if needed.
